  • 비타민 B2

Health Functional FoodNiacin 15mgBiotin 30μgVitamin B1 1.2mgVitamin B2 1.4mgVitamin B6 1.5mgSelenium 55μgZinc 8.5mgPantothenic acid 5mgOnce a day

에너지포텐BNiacin · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Selenium · Zinc · Pantothenic acid

Made by (주)서흥 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 30μg of Biotin, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 55μg of Selenium, 8.5mg of Zinc, 5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 15mg Niacin, 30μg Biotin, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 55μg Selenium, 8.5mg Zinc, 5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)서흥

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (15mg / 0.7g), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (30μg / 0.7g), 80~180%
Vitamin B1 labelled (1.2mg / 0.7g), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.4mg / 0.7g), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 0.7g), 80~150%
Selenium labelled (55μg / 0.7g), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 0.7g), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (5mg / 0.7g), 80~180%
Appearance 갈색 점박이가 있는 노란 하얀색의 장방형 제피정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일부터 24개월
Storage ① 제품은 직사광선을 피하고, 실온에서 보관 유통하십시오. ② 제품 개봉 후에는 흡습되지 않게 밀봉하여 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Selenium · Zinc · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Consult a professional if you have a condition or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Keep out of reach of children · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
